thread.title: Is Friday's Stock Market Blowup the Sign of Something Bigger?

author: thestreet.com
title: Is Friday's Stock Market Blowup the Sign of Something Bigger?
text:
What a day in the markets on Friday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average cratered to the tune of 665 points by the close. A combo of a too-hot January employment report and rising bond yields spooked investors by midday. Also not helping sentiment were mixed earnings results from tech heavyweights such as Apple ( AAPL ) and Alphabet ( GOOGL ) .
Buckle up investors, Friday could get rocky.
